entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Setting RuntimeAsync=1 broke wasm #122672
  • [infra] npm error code ECONNRESET #122671
  • [mono] mono_thread_info_install_interrupt: previous_token should be INTERRUPT_STATE #122669
  • `CharSearchValuesPolyfill._ascii` should be 128 bits length #122667
  • [API Proposal]: Support for ITU-T X.509 Alternative Signature #122659

Closed

  • [wasm][coreclr] Bring WBT tests on coreclr, make a few non-workload WBT tests work #120647
    11.0.0
  • Faulty async write of big chunks of data to HTTP stream with Transfer-Encoding: Chunked on Linux systems #122660
  • [8.0] CMake build failure in linux armel tizen - ld.lld: error: cannot open crtbeginS.o: No such file or directory #111279
  • Blazor WebAssembly - `ZipArchiveEntry.Open` causes unexpected termination at runtime in published app on .NET 10 Preview 3 and 4 #115780
    Future
  • `Marshal.SizeOf<T>` is not alloc free on AOT #122666
  • Redundant test after `PopCount` #118811
    Future
  • AsyncHelpers used in async thunks may not have references in the ReadyToRun version bubble #121722
    11.0.0
  • Proposal: GPU Execution of C# functions #77609
  • Enable platform installers for Ubuntu Arm32 #2401
  • [wasm] [MONO] * Assertion at /__w/1/s/src/runtime/src/mono/mono/metadata/appdomain.c:188, condition `<disabled>' not met #121840
  • Blazor WASM: DateTime.MinValue not usable for comparison once page loaded in WASM #122584
    10.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Always read from underlying stream in StreamPipeReader #122670
    Servicing-consider, 10.0.x
  • Fix CharSearchValuesPolyfill._ascii array size from 8 to 4 elements #122668
  • Add exit code check after bootstrap build in eng/build.ps1 #122665
    area-Infrastructure
  • Add zstd library files to the repo #122663
    area-System.IO.Compression
  • Move managed type system APIs to UTF-8 #122658
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Add an "auto-bisect" tool that can bisect AzDO builds to find the first failing commit #122657
    area-Infrastructure
  • [DRAFT] [clr-interp] Fix some interop suite issues #122656
    needs-area-label

Merged

  • [browser] Support CoreCLR in WebAssembly SDK #122495
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreclr] Add --UseMonoRuntime parameter to wasmbrowser template (default: true) #122641
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Extend the "skip-test" optimization to all instructions that modify the #120876
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [clr-interp] Fix regression caused by my recent changes #122655
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • [clr-interp] Enable rejit in the interpreter #122626
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr

Updated

  • Emit task returning thunks in crossgen2 #122651
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [release/8.0-staging] Update OpenSSL dependency for openSUSE and SLES #122654
    Servicing-approved, area-Setup
  • [browser][coreCLR] exit/abort/logging infra for unit testing #122646
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [clr-interp] Tweak GC reporting #122620
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • [clr-interp] Tracing fixes. #122467
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • ILC: track concrete dependencies of open generic methods #122012
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Implement ZStandard Stream, Encoder, Decoder #119575
    area-System.IO.Compression, 11.0.0
  • [Draft] Accelerate `Half` with FP16 ISA #122649
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Remove implicit string operator from Utf8String #122149
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [browser] Enable HotReload in Wasm.Build.Tests #119992
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • System.IO.Ports: check device capabilities for DTR/DSR in SerialStream Constructor/dispose (Windows) #122454
    community-contribution, area-System.IO.Ports
  • Split NativeAOT tests to use separate merged runners #120949
    area-Infrastructure, os-ios
  • Fix up hijacking on x64 platforms in presence of runtime async #122631
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122581
    area-codeflow
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122554
    area-codeflow
  • JIT: Move remaining xarch floating->integral cast implementation to lowering #117571
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
